title: Watersound Crossings 429 S Bridge Lane Unit 320A
h1: Watersound Crossings 429 S Bridge Lane Unit 320A
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - The primary and second bedrooms are both gulf-front with balcony access- Private deeded beach access- Pool and beach are just yards away- From March 1st to October 31st, 2024, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Fitness center- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout *This property comes with up to 2 first-come first-serve parking spaces. Please note first come first serve parking is limited and not guaranteed. This condo permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.*Beginning in March 2025 and continuing through 2026, the WaterSound Crossings condominiums will undergo an extensive exterior refurbishment project. During this period, residents and guests should expect significant construction activity, including the boarding of windows and restricted access to balconies in affected buildings. These measures are necessary to ensure safety and facilitate the successful completion of the work.DETAILS: Discover delightful days of beachside fun and sun at Unit 320A, a 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom WaterSound condo with Gulf-front views, sleeping up to 6 guests. Meandering boardwalks and sugar-soft beaches create a picturesque escape inside this private community. Hiking and biking trails, 2 community pools, and private beach access offer plenty of family-friendly activities—don’t forget to finish the day by grabbing dinner and drinks at The Big Chill! Guests will love waking up to the panoramic Gulf views and spending sun-soaked days exploring the beach yards away.A serene setting of neutral décor and natural light welcomes guests. Floor-to-ceiling windows along the great room’s back wall frame views of the glistening Gulf and rolling dunes. Wind down with an evening of quiet relaxation in the living area, where a plush sofa and 2 soft armchairs surround the TV. When hunger strikes, the gourmet kitchen offers high-end appliances for whipping up meals of fresh, local seafood. Enjoy quick bites at the 4-stool breakfast bar or settle around the 6-person dining table for a sit-down meal beside the Gulf views. A primary bedroom with a king bed and 2 guest bedrooms—both with queen beds—provide comfortable accommodations. The primary bedroom and first guest bedroom feature doors to the back deck, which is also accessible via the great room. Curl up on the cushioned furniture or delight in a morning brunch at the table for 6 while overlooking the endless turquoise water.Enjoy an indulgent retreat with Gulf-front views, community pools, and beach access at Unit 320A. On-site parking makes visiting the nearby communities of 30A a breeze. Book this beachfront paradise today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 6):FIRST FLOOR- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Hallway Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community and 360 Blue fines.
